requirements.evidence: Geometry only is checked by configurator. Parts are 3D-printed plastic; no load rating, material strength, or print setting is verified. Build provides two small shelf decks (covers on 1,0,0 and 0,0,1) staged with book props to show shelf purpose, but 50 kg capacity cannot be claimed.
Two half-base drawers placed: drawer:0#0,1#cut (north half) and drawer:0#1,-1#cut (south half) on level 0.

finish.summary: Built compact two-level shelf with two drawers and open shelf tops staged with books. 50 kg rating cannot be verified in this system and is marked unmet.

M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
The system could not directly verify a 50 kg load rating — the configurator only checks geometry and fit, not strength, material, or print parameters.

**Build description:** Two-level Hex Cluster shelf unit (3 full bases + 2 half-bases) with solid top covers forming two open shelf decks (lower deck ~166×144 mm on cover 1,0,0 and upper deck ~166×144 mm on cover 0,0,1) plus two integrated half-base drawers at ground level. Parts capped and joint-bolted; staged with book props on the upper shelf to show purpose.

* Visual load capacity is not verifiable in this printed-plastic system and requires engineering analysis and testing in the chosen material; no rating claim can be made.
